However, this surgery is Extremely Incompetent and unsafe for practice, in both my personal and professional opinion.

Unfortunately these are some of the experiences I’ve had to go through:

The surgery pharmacist stops medication without speaking to you or giving you a rationale, leaving you without the medication that was improving your health.

It took the GP over 5 months to do ONE referral (which ended up being done by the secretary anyway), she clearly forgot to do it time and time again, as she only needed to task the secretary to do it in the first place.

The same GP Offered me medication that I’m extremely allergic to (didn’t read my notes). This should never happen to a patient.

I rang to rearrange an appointment (I was given a new date and time), only to come in for my new appointment and be told that not only did they not book me this appointment, I wouldn’t be able to book another appointment unless I ring back at 08:30am. I should add that they marked me as a DNA for the original appointment that I had rearranged, which is a complete waste of time and NHS money. Not to mention that appointment could have gone to someone else!

A specific GP’s appointments are far too long with little to no substance coming off the back of them. For too long I have seen this GP who either didn’t know what she was talking about, failed to start treatment, delayed treatment, delayed referrals, needed a second opinion but forgot to actually ask this opinion (leaving me in severe pain for 2 months and I ended up in A&E).

I have now registered with a different surgery and I would urge others to do the had to call three times asking them to change my prescription.

About 6 weeks prior to this, I had an appointment to discuss changing my prescription and she told me to ring if I want to go through with this after me saying I wasn’t sure yet. So I rang back, mentioned how I wanted to change it and they said they’d update it for me. I rang again a week later to tell them it hasn’t been updated, they said they’ll text me when it’s been changed. I received nothing again. I rang back again and said once again it hasn’t been updated. The receptionist went to check with my doctor and then came back to me and said just to do it through the pharmacy.

The pharmacy was a lot better and got it sorted for me within minutes. They explained about the medication a lot better too.

I feel like some of the doctors here do poor service in regard to getting prescriptions updated and changed. It took me 6 weeks for me to finally change what I was on, after weeks of asking them to update
